bio.text: Mike Prax, a Republican, has represented District 33 in the Alaska House of Representatives, taking the oath of office on February 24, 2020, according to the Alaska Legislature.
The legislative biography says Prax lives in North Pole, Alaska, and graduated from A.E. Lathrop High School in 1974.
It lists career experience owning Prospector Outfitters and working as an operations technician with Alyeska Pipeline Service Company.
